conflicts.description: Two providers proposed different fixes for the same extractor defect.
conflicts.contestedAction: Rewriting src/example.js while two providers disagree on the approach.
conflicts.rationaleSummary: Both proposals are plausible and the evidence does not yet separate them, so the contested mutation is frozen and every position is preserved for the owner.
evidence: test/example.test.js currently passes under both proposals
neither proposal has been run against the real corpus
alternatives: Normalise at read time, leaving stored data untouched.
Normalise at write time, migrating stored data once.

positions.position: Read-time normalisation is the safer first step.

responses.response: Write-time is faster but needs a migration plan first.

corroboration.rationaleSummary: Three providers lean read-time, one is partial. Agreement is evidence, not proof, and does not authorise the change.

resolution.rationaleSummary: No AI may resolve this; both positions are preserved until the owner rules.
